fonts.display: 'SF Pro Display', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'SF Pro Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Apple Ink
palette.role: Primary text, card borders, structural outlines — near-black with a hint of warmth prevents harshness against the fog canvas

palette.name: Fog Canvas
palette.role: Page background, badge fills, secondary surfaces — the signature Apple light gray that defines the gallery atmosphere

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, icon fills, elevated layers above fog canvas

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text, subdued borders, nav dividers

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Muted helper text, tertiary metadata, de-emphasized labels

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Nav bar elements, button borders on dark surfaces, structural strokes

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Nav text and borders, link borders in secondary contexts

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Body text in lower-emphasis contexts, subtle borders

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Ghost button backgrounds, inactive chip surfaces, soft separators

palette.name: Electric Blue
palette.role: Buy button fill, primary action background — the only chromatic surface in the system, reserved exclusively for conversion

palette.name: Link Blue
palette.role: Inline text links, Learn more arrows, navigational text accents
